label: copy-phase update gate, length/position-specific (L=3 copy, L=4 recall 2, L=9 recall 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase: never on original-input or <DEL> steps, never at recall_idx 0, and never on the first occurrence of a token (in_first=1). Strongest and most reliable for L=3 sequences, where it fires on almost every copy step (99% precision) and gives the top activations, peaking at the second copied token. Other dense pockets are L=4 at recall_idx 2 (57% precision) and L=9 at recall_idx 3 (50%), with a weaker one at L=9 recall_idx 8 (22%). For L=6-9 it fires sparsely (10-20% of steps) on middle copy steps (recall_idx 3-5). Which of those steps fire depends on the token, with mild lifts for input g/i, but no simple token rule captures it. It almost never fires for L=5 or at recall_idx 1 when L>=5. The predicate covers the dense pockets: about 60% precision and 47% of activation mass on dev. Most of the remaining mass is the diffuse middle-copy activity in long sequences.
